name: Health Lab VSB - TU Ostrava
tagline: Open code and data from biomedical engineering research
intro: We develop methods and open tools for non-contact and wearable monitoring of human physiology — from mmWave radar vital-sign sensing to biosignal analysis and medical image processing.
affiliation: Department of Cybernetics and Biomedical Engineering, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, VSB – Technical University of Ostrava, Czech Republic

areas.name: Radar sensing
areas.description: Contactless measurement of respiration, heart rate and activity with TI mmWave radars.

areas.name: Biosignals & stress
areas.description: EEG, fNIRS, GSR and HR/HRV during meditation, relaxation and stress.

areas.name: Blood pressure
areas.description: Validation of non-invasive blood-pressure measurement in clinical practice.

areas.name: Medical imaging
areas.description: Retinal vessel segmentation and diagnosis support for retinopathy of prematurity.
